title: The Ticket field-group registry (E19-B §2.3; ADR-0016 §1; register F4)
description: Assigns every revision-governed Ticket input to exactly one primary field group, names each field's canonicalization rule (E19-B §2.4), and lists every other work-unit key as provenance or engine bookkeeping. Its identity is `aew/ticket-field-registry/v<version>@<sha256 of its canonical JSON>`; every digest binding cites it. A later version names its predecessor and lists the fields it moves, each counted as changed in both groups (E19-B §2.3).

predecessor.description: The identity of the version this one replaces; null for version 1

unassigned.description: The group an unclassified input fails closed into: the broadest acceptance-bearing group (E19-B §2.3)

record.description: Fields of the Ticket's record, by dotted path into its frontmatter; `body` is the record's Markdown body

control.description: Keys of the unit in control state. A key with `via` is hashed only through that derived value

derived.description: Values the engine derives from the unit and its ancestors (the effective obligations and edges)

provenance.description: Record fields that are not inputs: they identify and attribute the record, and are never hashed

bookkeeping.description: Control-state unit keys that are engine bookkeeping, each changed only by its own governed path; never hashed

moves.description: Fields this version moves between groups (empty for version 1); each counts as changed in both

also.description: Further groups the value feeds, for a key hashed through derived values

via.description: For rule `via`: the derived values that carry this key into its groups
